values: Use this workbook as the weekly source-of-truth before publishing a Frankfurt answer. A topic is not public content. Only records marked Reviewed with a primary source, last verified date, next review date, and named reviewer may feed a public answer page. Read docs/knowledge-refinery-operating-system.md before editing.
Choose up to five due or high-intent topic records.
Check primary sources; never rely on generic AI output.
Save exact source URLs, source titles, dates, bilingual document names, and scope.
Mark a record Reviewed only when its evidence and dates are complete.
Create or refresh one answer page with sources, dates, and one clear next action.
Use a qualified professional for individual legal, tax, insurance, or medical decisions.

After you actually move into a Frankfurt home, register your residence within two weeks. Use the online route only if you meet its identity requirements; otherwise use any Frankfurt Citizens’ Office.
City of Frankfurt: Registration of residence
Reviewed against listed primary source; re-check at the scheduled cadence.

Temporary housing is not automatically exempt from registration. The answer depends on where you are already registered, how long you will stay, and whether the provider can issue a valid Wohnungsgeberbestätigung after you move in.
confirmation from the landlord, if registration is required
Federal Registration Act §27: exemptions from registration duty
Reviewed against listed primary source; re-check at the scheduled cadence.
For Anmeldung, a rental agreement alone is not enough. You need a Wohnungsgeberbestätigung confirming the move-in; for a sublet, the main tenant can be the Wohnungsgeber.
Reviewed against listed primary source; re-check at the scheduled cadence.

Frankfurt generally requires appointments on Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday. Main Citizens’ Offices offer walk-in consultation on Monday and Wednesday, but waits can be long and ticket issue can stop early.
Reviewed against listed primary source; re-check at the scheduled cadence.

Your tax ID (Steueridentifikationsnummer or IdNr) is assigned automatically on first registration in Germany and stays the same for life. If it has not arrived within three months, request a renewed notification through the Federal Central Tax Office.
Federal Central Tax Office: receive a tax ID / renewed notification
Reviewed against listed primary source; re-check at the scheduled cadence.

Frankfurt has no official universal renter-packet or SCHUFA substitute. Prepare only the documents a provider asks for, minimise sensitive information, and ask in advance what alternative evidence they will consider if you have no German credit history.
rental agreement, if you already have one
Reviewed against listed primary source; re-check at the scheduled cadence.

For 2026, employees earning more than €603 per month and at or below €77,400 per year are generally compulsorily insured through statutory health insurance (GKV). Above that annual threshold, the choice and consequences need individual care.
Federal Ministry of Health: statutory health-insurance members
Reviewed against listed primary source; re-check at the scheduled cadence.

For Frankfurt’s EU Blue Card process, register your Frankfurt residence first and submit the application while your visa is valid (or within 90 days where you are visa-exempt). The City requires all requested scans before the online application can be sent.
Frankfurt Immigration Office: EU Blue Card
